jurisdiction_sources.note: 16 V.S.A. section 603 inventory: St. Johnsbury School District, a town school district that is its own supervisory district (member town: St. Johnsbury). Operates PK-8; tuitions grades 9-12.

board.post_note: St. Johnsbury SD: five directors at-large under 16 V.S.A. section 423(a)-(b), elected by Australian ballot; the stagger is currently irregular because two seats reached the 2026 ballot as vacancy remainders.

sources.note: 2025 Town of St. Johnsbury Annual Report (official), pp. 65-66: the March 3, 2026 warning elects three directors -- one for 3 years, one for 2 years, one for "the remaining 1 year of a 3 year term" -- and the Elected Officials list publishes Petty 2027 and Stavseth 2028 (neither on the 2026 ballot). The district's official results post (stjsd.org, Mar. 5, 2026) names the winners: "Three-Year Term: Abigail Campbell; Two-Year Term: Colleen Morris; One-Year Term: Joseph Achilles." The January 2026 warning's signature block names the same five as the current board page -- NO turnover at the 2026 election. The warned remainder-length terms imply a prior vacancy-appointment history for the Morris/Achilles seats, undocumented in fetched sources (resolving documents: 2024-2025 board minutes); both now hold elected seats. (The report's jumbled two-column extraction places the names Turek and Fox adjacent to the directors list -- neither signed the warning nor appears on the board page; neither is treated as a director. VSBA's "Campbell ends 2028" is stale against the district's own 2026 results.)
